bites.title: Five neighborhoods
bites.body: Krita's window has five neighborhoods. Don't memorize them, just learn where to look: 1. Toolbox (left): brushes, selections, transform, fill. 2. Tool Options: settings for whatever tool is active. 3. The canvas in the middle. The star of the show. 4. Dockers (right): Layers, Brush Presets, color selectors. And me! 5. Toolbar and menus on top: brush size, opacity, flow, blend mode.

bites.title: Home base: the brush
bites.body: Press {key:KritaShape/KisToolBrush|B}. The Freehand Brush Tool lights up in the toolbox. Whenever you're lost, B brings you home.

bites.title: The Move tool
bites.body: Press {key:KritaTransform/KisToolMove|T} for the Move tool, then drag on the canvas. It slides the whole active layer.

bites.title: The Fill tool
bites.body: Press {key:KritaFill/KisToolFill|F}: the paint bucket. We'll use it for flats later.

bites.title: The Color Sampler
bites.body: Press {key:KritaSelected/KisToolColorSampler|P}: the eyedropper. Click any color on the canvas to grab it.

bites.title: Back to the brush
bites.body: And {key:KritaShape/KisToolBrush|B} again. Brush, move, fill, sample, brush. That's 80% of a painting day.

bites.title: Brush Presets
bites.body: Press {key:show_brush_presets|F6} to pop up the Brush Presets. The same list lives in a docker: Settings > Dockers > Brush Presets.

bites.title: Find the Layers docker
bites.body: Make sure the Layers docker is showing. Missing? Settings > Dockers > Layers. We'll live in it from lesson 07 on.

bites.title: The rescue button
bites.body: Dockers flying everywhere? Window > Workspace > Default puts the furniture back. Every student breaks their workspace once. Now you know the fix.

bites.title: 01 cleared
bites.body:
Toolbox, options, canvas, dockers, menus. Plus B, T, F, P and the rescue button.

Next: moving around the canvas like you own it.
